en.s: The Battle of Dunsinane, also known as the Battle of the Seven Sleepers, was fought between the forces of Macbeth, King of Scotland and forces led by Siward, Earl of Northumbria and Malcolm Canmore on 27 July 1054. The battle was part of a campaign launched by Siward in support of Malcolm's claim to the Scottish throne, which Macbeth had gained after killing Malcolm's father, Duncan I of Scotland, at the Battle of Pitgaveny in 1040.

zh.s: 邓西嫩战役又称七眠者战役，于1054年7月27日发生，交战双方是苏格兰国王麦克白的部队与诺森伯兰伯爵西沃德和马尔科姆·坎莫尔率领的军队。战役属于西沃德支持马尔科姆争夺苏格兰王位的军事行动；麦克白在1040年皮特加夫尼战役中杀死马尔科姆的父亲、苏格兰国王邓肯一世后，夺取了王位。

en.s: The Battle of Bouvines, which took place on 27 July 1214, was a medieval battle which ended the 1202–1214 Anglo-French War. It was fundamental in the early development of France in the Middle Ages by confirming the French crown's sovereignty over the Angevin lands of Brittany and Normandy. Philip Augustus of France defeated an army consisting of Imperial German, English and Flemish soldiers, led by Otto IV of Germany. Other leaders included Count Ferrand of Flanders, William de Longespee and Renaud of Boulogne.

zh.s: 布汶战役于1214年7月27日发生，是一场中世纪战役，并结束了1202—1214年的英法战争。此战确认法国王室对布列塔尼和诺曼底安茹领地的主权，对法国中世纪早期的发展至关重要。法国国王腓力二世击败了由德国皇帝奥托四世率领的帝国德意志、英格兰和佛兰德士兵组成的联军。联军其他首领包括佛兰德伯爵费朗、威廉·德·朗斯皮和布洛涅的雷诺。

en.t: Battle of Bapheus: Decisive Ottoman victory over the Byzantines opening up Bithynia for Turkish conquest
en.s: The Battle of Bapheus occurred on 27 July 1299, between an Ottoman Turkish army under Osman I and a Byzantine army under Georgios Mouzalon. The battle ended in a crucial Ottoman victory, cementing the Ottoman state and heralding the final capture of Byzantine Bithynia by the Ottoman Turks.

zh.t: 拜菲乌斯战役：奥斯曼对拜占庭取得决定性胜利，为征服比提尼亚打开通道
zh.s: 拜菲乌斯战役于1299年7月27日爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼一世率领的奥斯曼土耳其军队和乔治·穆扎隆率领的拜占庭军队。战役以奥斯曼决定性胜利告终，巩固了奥斯曼政权，并预示着奥斯曼土耳其人最终将夺取拜占庭的比提尼亚。

en.s: The Battle of Medininkai took place on 27 July 1320 between the Teutonic Order and the Samogitian army near Medininkai (now Varniai).

zh.s: 梅迪宁凯战役于1320年7月27日发生在梅迪宁凯（今瓦尔尼艾）附近，交战双方为条顿骑士团和萨莫吉希亚军队。

en.s: The Battle of Pyzdry took place on 27 July 1331 between the Teutonic Order led by Dietrich von Altenburg and the Kingdom of Poland. On 22 July 1331, Teutonic forces crossed the Vistula at Wyszogród and ravaged through Bydgoszcz, Inowrocław, and Słupca, reaching Pyzdry on 27 July. The city was captured in the absence of Prince Casimir as the future king had been evacuated, leaving the troops in Pyzdry led by the governor of Poznań Vincent of Szamotuł. Pyzdry was captured, looted and burned. Polish forces were too weak to break the branches of the Teutonic Knights and after incurring severe losses withdrew west in the direction of Poznań.

zh.s: 1331年7月27日，条顿骑士团与波兰王国在皮兹德里交战。7月22日，条顿军队在维绍格鲁德渡过维斯瓦河，沿途劫掠比得哥什、伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫和斯武普察，并于7月27日抵达皮兹德里。未来的国王卡齐米日亲王已被转移到安全地点，不在城内；城中部队由波兹南总督文森特·沙莫图乌指挥。皮兹德里被攻占、洗劫并焚毁。波兰军队实力不足，无法击退条顿骑士团的分队，在损失惨重后向西撤往波兹南。

en.s: The Battle of Visby was fought in 1361 near the town of Visby on the island of Gotland, Sweden, between the forces of the Danish king and the Gutnish country yeomen. The Danish force was victorious.

zh.s: 维斯比战役于1361年在瑞典哥特兰岛维斯比镇附近发生，交战双方是丹麦国王的部队和哥特兰岛的农民。丹麦军队获胜。

en.s: Valdemar Atterdag's invasion of Gotland took place in July 1361. The troops of the Danish King Valdemar Atterdag won several battles on Gotland against Gutnish troops, the last outside Visby on 27 July. The inhabitants of Visby surrendered and opened the city gates to the victor, after which the so-called fire assessment of Visby took place, an event surrounded by several myths.

zh.t: 瓦尔德马四世入侵哥特兰岛
zh.s: 瓦尔德马四世于1361年7月入侵哥特兰岛。丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世的军队在岛上与哥特兰军队多次交战，并于7月27日在维斯比城外进行最后一战。维斯比居民随后投降，并为胜者打开城门。之后发生了所谓的“维斯比火灾征税”，围绕这一事件流传着许多传说。

en.s: Battle of Brännkyrka took place on 27 July 1518 in Sweden, during a Swedish uprising against the Danish dominance in Kalmar Union, between Danish forces and Swedish rebel troops. The battle resulted in decisive Swedish victory.

zh.s: 布伦克耶卡战役于1518年7月27日在瑞典发生，是瑞典反抗丹麦在卡尔马联盟中主导地位的起义期间，丹麦军队与瑞典叛军之间的一场战斗。瑞典军队取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The siege of Temesvár was a military conflict between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Empire in 1552. The siege resulted with a decisive Ottoman victory and Temesvár came under Ottoman control for 164 years.

zh.s: 1552年，哈布斯堡君主国与奥斯曼帝国在泰梅什堡发生军事冲突。奥斯曼帝国取得决定性胜利，并控制泰梅什堡长达164年。

en.s: The second siege of Jinju was a battle fought on 1593 at Jinju Fortress during the Imjin War. It occurred from 20 July to 27 July and ended in the massacre of the entire garrison and a substantial portion of the population. The Second Battle of Jinju became the origin of the Uwajima Ushi-oni Festival in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture, Japan.

zh.s: 1593年，日军在壬辰倭乱期间围攻晋州城。第二次晋州围城战于7月20日至27日进行，最终守军和大量居民遭到屠杀。此次战役后来成为日本爱媛县宇和岛市牛鬼节的起源。

en.s: The battle of Ristilahti occurred on 27 July 1614 during the Ingrian War. The Swedish troops, under Hans Munck and Hans Stålhandske managed to rout the Russian troops, consolidating Sweden's grip on Kexholm county.

zh.s: 里斯蒂拉赫蒂战役发生于1614年7月27日的英格里亚战争期间。汉斯·蒙克和汉斯·斯托尔汉德斯克率领的瑞典军队击溃俄军，巩固了瑞典对凯克斯霍尔姆县的控制。

en.s: The Battle of Karaharman was a major naval battle that took place on 27 July 1625 between the Zaporozhian Cossacks and the Ottoman fleet, it is considered to be one of the biggest defeats of the Cossack fleet in the course of their naval campaigns.

zh.s: 卡拉赫尔曼海战于1625年7月27日发生在扎波罗热哥萨克与奥斯曼舰队之间，是一场重要海战。它被认为是哥萨克海上征战过程中遭遇的最大败仗之一。

en.s: The first siege of Hull marked an escalation in the conflict between King Charles I and Parliament during the preliminaries of the First English Civil War. Charles sought to secure the large arsenal held in Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire. He first approached the town in late April 1642 and was rebuffed by the town's Parliamentarian governor, Sir John Hotham.

zh.s: 第一次赫尔围城战标志着英国内战前期，查理一世与议会之间的冲突升级。查理一世希望夺取东约克郡金斯顿赫尔存放的大量军火。1642年4月下旬，他首次抵达该镇，但遭到议会派镇长约翰·霍瑟姆爵士拒绝入城。

en.s: The Battle of Körmend was a military engagement that took place on June 26–27, 1664, as part of the Austro-Turkish War (1663–1664). Although not a major engagement in the broader context of the conflict, it nonetheless played a huge role in the subsequent Christian victory at the Battle of Saint Gotthard.

zh.s: 克尔门德战役是1664年6月26日至27日发生的一场军事交战，属于奥土战争（1663—1664年）的一部分。尽管它在整场冲突中并非重大交战，却对随后基督教联军在圣戈特哈德战役中的胜利发挥了重要作用。

en.s: The Battle of Salzbach or Sasbach was fought July 27, 1675, between the armies of France and the Holy Roman Empire, during the Franco-Dutch War. The term "battle" is something of a misnomer because the encounter consisted primarily of an artillery duel. However, it was costly for the French: the great French marshal, the Vicomte de Turenne, was killed by a cannonball.

zh.s: 萨尔茨巴赫战役又称萨斯巴赫战役，于1675年7月27日发生在法荷战争期间，交战双方为法国和神圣罗马帝国军队。称其为“战役”并不十分准确，因为交战主要是炮兵对射。法国损失惨重，名将蒂雷纳子爵被炮弹击中身亡。

en.s: The Battle of Killiecrankie (Gaelic: Cath Raon Ruairidh) was fought between Highland Scottish clans supporting King James II and VII and troops supporting King William of Orange on 27 July 1689, during the first Jacobite uprising. Although it was a stunning victory for the Jacobites, it had little overall effect on the outcome of the war and left their leader dead. Their forces were scattered at the Battle of Dunkeld the next month. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009.

zh.s: 基利克兰基战役（盖尔语：Cath Raon Ruairidh）于1689年7月27日发生，是第一次詹姆斯党起义期间支持詹姆斯二世及七世的苏格兰高地氏族与支持奥兰治亲王威廉的部队之间的战斗。詹姆斯党虽取得压倒性胜利，但这对战争结局影响不大，且他们的首领阵亡。次月，其部队在邓凯尔德战役中被击溃。战场已列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并依据2009年苏格兰历史环境政策受历史苏格兰保护。

en.s: The Raid on Groton happened during King William's War, on July 27, 1694, at Groton, Massachusetts. This was one of numerous attacks against the settlement in the late 17th and early 18th centuries. The village had been raided during King Philip's War and temporarily abandoned by numerous families. It was also raided in June 1707 during Queen Anne's War.

zh.s: 格罗顿突袭发生于1694年7月27日的威廉王战争期间，地点为马萨诸塞州格罗顿。这是17世纪末至18世纪初针对该定居点的多次袭击之一。该村庄曾在菲利普国王战争期间遭袭，当时许多家庭暂时离开。1707年6月，安妮女王战争期间该村庄再次遭袭。

en.s: The Bank of England (BoE) is the central bank of the United Kingdom and the model on which most modern central banks have been based. Established in 1694 to act as the English Government's banker and debt manager, and still one of the bankers for the government of the United Kingdom, it is the world's second oldest central bank, after Sweden's (1668).

zh.s: 英格兰银行是英国的中央银行，也是许多现代中央银行的范本。它于1694年成立，负责为英格兰政府提供银行和债务管理服务；至今仍为英国政府提供部分银行服务。它是世界第二古老的中央银行，仅次于1668年成立的瑞典央行。

en.s: The Battle of Almenar took place near Balaguer in Catalonia, on 27 July 1710, during the War of the Spanish Succession. In June 1710, the Bourbon-Spanish army of Phillip V crossed into Catalonia in an attempt to capture Balaguer; an Allied force of British, Portuguese, Dutch and Austrian troops supporting Archduke Charles countered these moves and the two armies met in battle just to the north of Lleida on the afternoon of 27 July.

zh.s: 阿尔梅纳尔战役于1710年7月27日在加泰罗尼亚巴拉格尔附近发生，属于西班牙王位继承战争的一部分。1710年6月，腓力五世率领的波旁王朝西班牙军队进入加泰罗尼亚，企图攻占巴拉格尔；支持查理大公的英、葡、荷、奥盟军对此作出反击。两军于7月27日下午在莱里达以北交战。

en.s: The Battle of Gangut (Russian: Гангутское сражение; Finnish: Riilahden taistelu; Finland Swedish: Slaget vid Rilax; Swedish: Sjöslaget vid Hangö udd) took place on 27 JulyJul./ 7 August 1714Greg. during the Great Northern War (1700–1721), in the waters of Riilahti Bay, north of the Hanko Peninsula, near the site of the modern-day city of Hanko (Hangö), Finland, between the Swedish Navy and Imperial Russian Navy.
en.n: The Great Northern War: The first significant victory of the Russian Navy in the naval battle of Gangut against the Swedish Navy near the Hanko Peninsula.

zh.t: 汉科半岛附近的甘古特海战
zh.s: 甘古特海战发生于1714年7月27日（儒略历）／8月7日（公历），是大北方战争期间的一场海战。交战双方是瑞典海军和俄罗斯帝国海军，战场位于芬兰汉科半岛北侧的里拉赫蒂湾附近。
zh.n: 大北方战争期间，俄罗斯海军在甘古特附近的海战中首次取得重大胜利。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: Founding of the U.S. Army Medical Department: The Second Continental Congress passes legislation establishing "an hospital for an army consisting of 20,000 men."

zh.s: 第二届大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三个殖民地的代表组成，他们团结起来支持美国革命和独立战争，最终促成美国脱离英国独立。会议建立了一个新的联邦，最初称为“北美联合殖民地”，并于1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 美国陆军医疗部成立：第二届大陆会议通过法案，决定“为一支由2万人组成的军队设立一所医院”。

en.s: The Battle of Ushant (also called the First Battle of Ushant) took place on 27 July 1778, and was fought between French and British fleets 100 miles (160 km) west of Ushant, an island at the mouth of the English Channel off the north-westernmost point of France. The battle, which was the first major naval engagement in the Anglo-French War, ended indecisively and led to political conflicts in both countries.

zh.s: 韦桑岛海战又称第一次韦桑岛海战，于1778年7月27日发生在韦桑岛以西100英里（160公里）的海域，交战双方为法国和英国舰队。韦桑岛位于英吉利海峡入口处、法国最西北端外海。这是英法战争中的首次大规模海战，战斗未分胜负，并引发两国国内的政治冲突。

en.s: During the French Revolution, Maximilien Robespierre addressed the National Convention on 26 July 1794, was arrested the next day, and executed the day after, on 28 July. In his speech on 26 July, Robespierre spoke of the existence of internal enemies, conspirators, and calumniators, within the Convention and the governing Committees.

zh.t: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔倒台
zh.s: 法国大革命期间，马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔于1794年7月26日在国民公会发表演说，次日被捕，并于7月28日处决。7月26日的演说中，罗伯斯庇尔称国民公会及执政委员会内部存在敌人、阴谋者和诽谤者。

en.s: The Battle of Vitebsk, sometimes spelled Witepsk, was a military engagement that took place on 26 and 27 July 1812 during the French invasion of Russia. The battle put a French force, under the command of Emperor Napoleon I, in combat with Russian rearguard forces under General Petr Konovnitsyn (on 26 July) and Peter Ludwig von der Pahlen (on 27 July) and ended with the Russian forces making a strategic retreat from the battlefield. The battle occurred as Napoleon was trying to envelop the Russian First Army at Vitebsk and force them to accept battle.

zh.s: 维捷布斯克战役又拼作Witepsk，于1812年7月26日至27日发生在法国入侵俄国期间。拿破仑一世率领的法军先在26日与彼得·科诺夫尼岑将军指挥的俄军后卫交战，次日又与彼得·冯·德·帕伦指挥的俄军交战，最终俄军从战场战略性撤退。此时拿破仑正试图包围驻扎在维捷布斯克的俄国第一集团军，迫使其应战。

en.s: The Battle of Kobrin, or the Battle of Kobryn, took place on 27 July 1812 between the Russian and Saxon forces – under the command of Alexander Tormasov and Jean Reynier respectively – in the city of Kobrin (Kobryn) at the initial stage of the French invasion of Russia. The battle was a clear victory of the Russian forces.

zh.s: 科布林战役（又作Kobryn战役）于1812年7月27日在法国入侵俄国初期发生于科布林市。交战双方为俄罗斯和萨克森军队，分别由亚历山大·托尔马索夫和让·雷尼耶指挥。俄军取得明显胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Burnt Corn, also known as the Battle of Burnt Corn Creek, was fought on July 27, 1813, in what is now Escambia County, Alabama, United States. The battle was the first conflict of the Creek War to be fought between American forces and a faction of the Muscogee known as the Red Sticks.

zh.s: 焦玉米战役又称焦玉米溪战役，于1813年7月27日在今美国阿拉巴马州埃斯坎比亚县发生。这是克里克战争中美军与马斯科吉族红棍派之间的第一场冲突。

en.s: Negro Fort was a short-lived fortification built by the British in 1814, during the War of 1812, in a remote part of what was at the time Spanish Florida. It was intended to support a never-realized British attack on the U.S. via its southwest border, by means of which they could "free all these Southern Countries [states] from the Yoke of the Americans".

zh.s: 黑人堡是英国人于1814年在1812年战争期间建造的一座短暂存在的堡垒，位于当时西属佛罗里达的一处偏远地区。建堡原意是为英国从美国西南边境发动攻击提供支援，但这一计划从未实现；其目标是“将南方各州从美国人的枷锁下解放出来”。

en.s: The Battle of Volta Mantovana of 1848 was an engagement during the First Italian War of Independence fought throughout Volta Mantovana on 26 and 27 July 1848 between the Second Austrian army corps of General Konstantin D'Aspré and the 3d Piedmontese division of general Ettore De Sonnaz. It resulted in a decisive Austrian victory.

zh.t: 沃尔塔曼托瓦纳战役（1848年）
zh.s: 1848年沃尔塔曼托瓦纳战役是第一次意大利独立战争期间的一场交战，于1848年7月26日至27日在沃尔塔曼托瓦纳全境发生。交战双方为康斯坦丁·达斯普雷将军指挥的奥地利第2军和埃托雷·德·索纳兹将军指挥的皮埃蒙特第3师。奥军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The siege of Arrah (27 July – 3 August 1857) took place during the Indian Mutiny (also known as the Indian Rebellion of 1857). It was the eight-day defence of a fortified outbuilding, occupied by a combination of 18 civilians and 50 members of the Bengal Military Police Battalion, against 2,500 to 3,000 mutinying Bengal Native Infantry sepoys from three regiments and an estimated 8,000 men from irregular forces commanded by Kunwar Singh, the local zamindar or chieftain who controlled the Jagdishpur estate.

en.s: The Action at Massard Prairie on July 27, 1864, exemplified the hit-and-run nature of the Civil War in Arkansas on the western border: this was a war of raids and ambushes involving small forces, not drawn-out, large-scale battles. As a Confederate victory, it also demonstrated the difficulty faced by Union units attempting to exert control over the state during the war’s later stages. Following the failure of Union General Frederick Steele’s Camden Expedition in April 1864, Confederate and Union roles on the frontier reversed. Union forces now attempted to hold the line of the Arkansas River against Confederate raids, while emboldened Confederates became more aggressive in their operations.

zh.s: 1864年7月27日的马萨德草原战斗，体现了美国内战期间阿肯色州西部边境的游击战特点：战事以小规模突袭和伏击为主，而非持续的大规模战斗。邦联军获胜，也显示联邦军难以在战争后期控制该州。1864年4月联邦军弗雷德里克·斯蒂尔将军的卡姆登远征失败后，边境战场上的攻守局势逆转。联邦军转而试图守住阿肯色河防线，抵御邦联军袭击；士气高涨的邦联军则愈加积极地展开行动。

en.s: The Battle of Maiwand on 27 July 1880 was one of the principal battles of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. Under the leadership of Ayub Khan, the Afghans defeated two brigades of British and Indian troops under Brigadier-General George Burrows, though at a high price: between 2,050 and 2,750 Afghan warriors were killed, and probably about 1,500 wounded. British and Indian forces suffered 969 soldiers killed and 177 wounded.

zh.s: 迈万德战役于1880年7月27日发生，是第二次英阿战争中的主要战役之一。阿富汗军队在阿尤布汗率领下，击败了乔治·伯罗斯准将指挥的两旅英印军队，但付出沉重代价：阿富汗战士死亡2050至2750人，可能另有约1500人受伤。英印军队有969名士兵阵亡、177人受伤。

en.s: The Khanasor Expedition (Armenian: Խանասորի արշավանք, romanized: Xanasori aršavank',) was a punitive raid launched by Armenian fedayis against the Kurdish Mazrik tribe on July 25, 1897. In 1896, in the aftermath of the Defense of Van, the Kurdish Mazrik tribe had ambushed and slaughtered many of the Armenian defenders of Van as they were retreating into Persia. The Armenian Revolutionary Federation decided to retaliate for that atrocity, resulting in the Khanasor Expedition.

zh.s: 哈纳索尔远征（亚美尼亚语：Խանասորի արշավանք）是亚美尼亚敢死队于1897年7月25日针对库尔德马兹里克部族发动的一次惩罚性袭击。1896年，范城保卫战后，马兹里克部族曾伏击并屠杀了许多撤往波斯的亚美尼亚守军。亚美尼亚革命联盟决定对这一暴行进行报复，因此发动了哈纳索尔远征。

en.s: The Burmi campaign was a series of military engagements in 1903 between the British Empire, through its protectorate in Northern Nigeria, and the Sokoto Caliphate. The campaign followed British victories across the Caliphate's emirates and the capture of its twin capitals, Sokoto and Gwandu. After losing Sokoto, Caliph Muhammadu Attahiru I embarked on a hijra with his followers, seeking to avoid British rule and ultimately settle in Mecca.

zh.s: 布尔米战役是1903年英国帝国通过其在尼日利亚北部的保护国对索科托哈里发国发动的一系列军事行动。此前，英国军队在哈里发国各酋长国取得一系列胜利，并攻占双都索科托和关杜。失去索科托后，哈里发穆罕默杜·阿塔希鲁一世带领追随者踏上希吉拉，试图逃避英国统治，最终前往麦加定居。

zh.s: 狼谷之战是西班牙军队与里夫军队之间的一场战斗，也被称为“狼谷灾难”。这场战斗给西班牙军队造成惨败。

en.s: The Battle of Agri Pass (Albanian: Beteja e Qafës së Agrit) was fought between Albanian rebels and Ottoman forces during the Revolt of 1910. The clash represented a military offensive launched by Shevket Turgut Pasha against Albanian rebels that were blocking the Agri Pass in the Bajrak of Nikaj-Mërtur. The Ottomans were defeated. According to Albanian sources the Albanians rebels attacked 3,000 Ottomans with 400-500 irregular soldiers.

zh.s: 1910年阿尔巴尼亚起义期间，阿尔巴尼亚叛军与奥斯曼军队在阿格里山口交战。这场冲突是谢夫凯特·图尔古特帕夏对封锁阿格里山口的阿尔巴尼亚叛军发动的一次军事进攻，地点在尼卡伊-默尔图尔巴伊拉克地区。奥斯曼军队战败。阿尔巴尼亚资料称，400至500名非正规军袭击了3000名奥斯曼士兵。

en.s: The 1920 Nova Scotia general election was held on 27 July 1920 to elect members of the 37th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. The Liberal party won a majority of seats in the Legislaure with only 44 per cent of the vote. This was the first general election in which women could vote and run for office.

en.s: The Battle of Santa Clara took place on July 27, 1927, during the American occupation of Nicaragua of 1926–1933. After being ambushed by Sandinista forces at the Battle of San Fernando, Major Oliver Floyd's expedition of American Marines and Nicaraguan Provisional Guardsmen continued its advance into enemy-held territory in northern Nicaragua. On July 27, two American airplanes spotted forty Sandinistas waiting in ambush. The aircraft received fire from an enemy machine gun and a dive bombing raid ensued, with three bombs being dropped on the Nicaraguan rebels. The American aviators reported seeing six Sandinistas "dead or seriously wounded."

zh.s: 圣克拉拉战役发生于1927年7月27日，是1926—1933年美国占领尼加拉瓜期间的一场战斗。奥利弗·弗洛伊德少校率领的美国海军陆战队和尼加拉瓜临时卫队在圣费尔南多战役中遭桑地诺部队伏击后，继续向尼加拉瓜北部敌占区推进。7月27日，两架美国飞机发现40名桑地诺士兵正在埋伏。飞机遭敌方机枪射击后发起俯冲轰炸，向尼加拉瓜反叛者投下3枚炸弹。美国飞行员报告称看到6名桑地诺士兵“死亡或重伤”。

en.t: Geneva Convention on Prisoners of War
en.s: The Geneva Convention on Prisoners of War was signed at Geneva, July 27, 1929. Its official name is the Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War. It entered into force 19 June 1931. It is this version of the Geneva Conventions which covered the treatment of prisoners of war during World War II. It is the predecessor of the Third Geneva Convention signed in 1949.

zh.s: 《日内瓦战俘公约》于1929年7月27日在日内瓦签署，正式名称为《关于战俘待遇的公约》。公约于1931年6月19日生效，是第二次世界大战期间战俘待遇所依据的日内瓦公约版本，也是1949年签署的第三公约的前身。

This was the second election in Manitoba after the formation of a Liberal-Progressive alliance in 1932.

en.s: The Drvar uprising (Serbian: Устанак у Дрвару) was the World War II uprising of the Serb population of Bosnian Krajina (present-day Bosnia and Herzegovina). Italy supported it, both politically and in arms, in its struggle against the fascist puppet state of the Independent State of Croatia between 27 July and 26 September 1941. The genocidal activities of the Independent State of Croatia forced the Serb population to organize an uprising.

en.s: The invasion of Buna–Gona, called Operation RI by the Japanese, was a military operation by Imperial Japanese forces to occupy the Buna–Gona area in the Territory of Papua during the Pacific campaign of the Second World War. The initial landings and advance on Kokoda occurred between 21 and 27 July 1942. The Japanese invaded and occupied the location in preparation for an overland attack on Port Moresby along the Kokoda Track.

zh.s: 布纳—戈纳入侵是第二次世界大战太平洋战场期间，日本帝国军队为占领巴布亚领地布纳—戈纳地区而实施的一次军事行动，日方称“RI行动”。1942年7月21日至27日，日军最初登陆并向科科达推进。日军入侵并占领该地，为沿科科达小道陆路进攻莫尔兹比港做准备。

zh.s: 第一次阿拉曼战役于1942年7月1日至27日进行，是第二次世界大战西部沙漠战役的一部分，战场位于埃及。交战双方为轴心国军队和盟军。轴心国一方由埃尔温·隆美尔元帅指挥的非洲装甲集团军参战，其中包括非洲军团；盟军一方则由克劳德·奥金莱克将军指挥的第八集团军参战，主要由英国及英联邦部队组成。

en.s: The Raid on Sidi Haneish Airfield was a military operation carried out the night of 26 July 1942. A British Special Air Service unit commanded by Major David Stirling attacked a German-held airfield in Egypt during the Western Desert Campaign of Second World War. Several Luftwaffe aircraft used to ferry supplies to the Axis forces were destroyed or damaged with machine-gun fire and explosives.

en.s: The Lwów Uprising (Polish: powstanie lwowskie) was an armed insurrection by the Home Army (Polish: Armia Krajowa) underground forces of the Polish resistance movement in World War II against the Nazi German occupation of the city of Lviv in the latter stages of World War II. en.t: 1949 Rhodesia vs New Zealand rugby union match

en.s: The Hadong Ambush was an engagement between United States and North Korean forces, occurring on July 27, 1950, in the village of Hadong in southern South Korea, early in the Korean War. The fight ended in a North Korean victory following a successful ambush of US forces which resulted in heavy American casualties. The US Army's 3rd Battalion, 29th Infantry Regiment, a newly formed unit consisting mostly of inexperienced new arrivals, was ordered to move to the South Korean village of Hadong to hold the pass there from advancing forces of the North Korean People's Army.

zh.s: 河东伏击战是朝鲜战争初期美国和朝鲜军队之间的一场交战，于1950年7月27日在韩国南部的河东村发生。朝鲜军队成功设伏并重创美军，最终获胜。美国陆军第29步兵团第3营是一支新组建部队，成员大多是缺乏经验的新兵；上级命令该部前往韩国河东村守住隘口，抵挡朝鲜人民军的推进。

en.s: The Korean Armistice Agreement (Korean: 한국정전협정; Hanja: 韓國停戰協定) is an armistice that brought about a cessation of hostilities of the Korean War. It was signed by United States Army Lieutenant General William Harrison Jr. and General Mark W. Clark representing the United Nations Command (UNC), North Korea leader Kim Il Sung and General Nam Il representing the Korean People's Army (KPA), and Peng Dehuai representing the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA). The armistice was signed on 27 July 1953, and came into force at 22:00 local time (UTC+09:00) the same day and was designed to "ensure a complete cessation of hostilities and of all acts of armed force in Korea until a final peaceful settlement is achieved."

zh.s: 《朝鲜停战协定》（韩语：한국정전협정；汉字：韩国停戰協定）结束了朝鲜战争中的敌对行动。协定由代表联合国军司令部的美国陆军中将威廉·哈里森二世和马克·克拉克上将、代表朝鲜人民军的朝鲜领导人金日成和南日将军，以及代表中国人民志愿军的彭德怀签署。协定于1953年7月27日签署，并于当天当地时间22时（协调世界时+09:00）生效。协定旨在确保“全面停止敌对行动以及朝鲜境内一切武装行为，直至达成最终和平解决”。

en.s: A by-election was called in the constituency of Littleborough and Saddleworth in Greater Manchester, England, on 27 July 1995 following the death of Conservative Party MP Geoffrey Dickens on 17 May of that year. The contest was a win for the Liberal Democrat candidate Chris Davies. The result was notable as the defending party dropped from first to third place, something which has not (as of October 2014) happened since in a UK by-election. The second-placed Labour candidate, Phil Woolas, defeated Davies at the 1997 General Election in the successor seat of Oldham East and Saddleworth. He held the seat until 2010.

zh.s: 1995年5月17日，保守党议员杰弗里·狄更斯去世后，英格兰大曼彻斯特郡利特尔伯勒和萨德尔沃思选区于7月27日举行补选。自由民主党候选人克里斯·戴维斯获胜。此次选举的特别之处在于，原执政党从第一名跌至第三名；截至2014年10月，这一情况此后未在英国补选中再次出现。排名第二的工党候选人菲尔·伍拉斯在1997年大选中于后继选区奥尔德姆东和萨德尔沃思击败戴维斯，并一直担任该席位议员至2010年。

en.s: The Centennial Olympic Park bombing was a pipe bombing attack on Centennial Olympic Park in Atlanta, Georgia, United States, on July 27, 1996, during the Summer Olympics. The blast directly killed one person and injured 111 others; another person later died of a heart attack. It was the first of four bombings committed by Eric Rudolph in a domestic terrorist campaign against the U.S. government which he accused of championing "the ideals of global socialism" and "abortion on demand".

en.s: The 2002 New Zealand general election was held on 27 July 2002 to determine the composition of the 47th New Zealand Parliament. It saw the reelection of Helen Clark's Labour Party government, as well as the worst-ever performance by the opposition National Party. Arguably the most controversial issue in the election campaign was the end of a moratorium on genetic engineering, strongly opposed by the Green Party. Some commentators have claimed that the tension between Labour and the Greens on this issue was a more notable part of the campaign than any tension between Labour and its traditional right-wing opponents.

en.s: The 2011 Major League Soccer All-Star Game, held on July 27, 2011, was the 16th annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, a soccer match involving all-stars from Major League Soccer. The MLS All-Stars faced Manchester United of the English Premier League for the second year running in the eighth MLS All-Star Game to feature international opposition. Manchester United won the game 4–0 with goals from Anderson, Park Ji-Sung, Dimitar Berbatov and Danny Welbeck.

zh.s: 2011年美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛于2011年7月27日举行，是第16届年度全明星赛，由美国职业足球大联盟的全明星球员参赛。全明星队连续第二年对阵英格兰超级联赛的曼联队，这也是第8场由国际球队参赛的美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛。曼联以4比0获胜，进球者分别是安德森、朴智星、迪米塔·贝尔巴托夫和丹尼·维尔贝克。

en.s: The 2012 Summer Olympics, officially the Games of the XXX Olympiad and also known as London 2012, were an international multi-sport event held from 27 July to 12 August 2012 in London, England. The match was hosted by Dortmund at the Signal Iduna Park on 27 July 2013.

en.s: On 27 July 2015 three gunmen dressed in army uniforms opened fire on a bus and then attacked the Dina Nagar police station in Gurdaspur district of Punjab, India. The attack resulted in the death of three civilians and four policemen, including a superintendent of police; fifteen others were injured. In addition, five bombs were found planted on the Amritsar–Pathankot line on a rail-bridge near Parmanand railway station, five kilometers from the site of the attack. All three attackers were killed in the operation, which lasted almost 12 hours.

zh.s: 2015年7月27日，3名身穿军服的枪手在印度旁遮普邦古达斯普尔县向一辆公交车开火，随后袭击迪纳纳加尔警察局。袭击造成3名平民和4名警察死亡，其中包括一名警司，另有15人受伤。此外，警方在距袭击地点5公里、帕尔马南德火车站附近的一座铁路桥上发现5枚已安放的炸弹，地点位于阿姆利则—帕坦科特铁路线上。历时近12小时的行动最终击毙了3名袭击者。

en.s: The Battle of Sarrin (June–July 2015) was a military operation during 2015 in the northeastern Aleppo Governorate, during the Syrian civil war, in which the Kurdish YPG and Free Syrian Army forces captured the town of Sarrin and the surrounding region from the Islamic State (IS). Following nearly two months of a stalled earlier offensive, YPG-led fighters renewed offensive operations on Sarrin on 18 June 2015, followed by a full-fledged operation on 1 July, after ISIL's Kobanî massacre.

zh.s: 萨林战役是2015年叙利亚内战期间发生在阿勒颇省东北部的一次军事行动。库尔德人民保卫军（YPG）和自由叙利亚军夺取了“伊斯兰国”控制的萨林镇及周边地区。此前，进攻行动已停滞近两个月；2015年6月18日，YPG领导的战士重新对萨林发动进攻，并于7月1日在“伊斯兰国”科巴尼大屠杀后展开全面行动。

en.s: The 2019 Johan Cruyff Shield was the 24th edition of the Johan Cruyff Shield (Dutch: Johan Cruijff Schaal), an annual Dutch football match played between the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup. en.s: The 2025 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was a Gaelic football match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 27 July 2025 between Donegal and Kerry, the culmination of the 2025 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship. en.s: The 24th New York Asian Film Festival opened in New York City on July 11, 2025 with South Korean film Informant by Kim Suk. This year’s theme is "Cinema as Disruption", reflecting a focus on bold, boundary-pushing storytelling. The festival presented over 100 films screened in person, featuring a diverse selection of both contemporary works and classic titles from across Asia and beyond.

en.s: The 8th Malaysia International Film Festival (MIFFest) took place from July 19 to July 27, 2025, in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Bront Palarae, was joined by Siti Saleha and Daiyan Trisha as the brand ambassadors of the festival. The festival opened with a Malaysian film exploring cultural identity and emotional heritage titled Ninavau by Bebbra Mailin. It closed with 2024 coming-of-age film Transamazonia by Pia Marais.
en.n: The 8th Malaysia International Film Festival (MIFFest) took place from July 19 to July 27, 2025, in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

zh.s: 第8届马来西亚国际电影节（MIFFest）于2025年7月19日至27日在马来西亚吉隆坡举行。勃朗特·帕拉雷、茜蒂·莎列哈和戴安·特丽莎担任电影节形象大使。开幕影片是贝布拉·梅林执导的马来西亚电影《想念》，讲述文化身份和情感传承。闭幕影片是皮娅·马莱斯执导的2024年成长题材电影《跨亚马逊》。
zh.n: 第8届马来西亚国际电影节（MIFFest）于2025年7月19日至27日在马来西亚吉隆坡举行。
